text: High-resolution synchrotron X-ray diffraction confirmed the phase purity and crystal symmetry of Bi2Te3 alloy. Detailed characterization revealed room temperature thermoelectric figure of merit ZT ~ 1.0, 3D topological insulator with gapless Dirac surface states in quintuple layers.. Transport measurements on tetradymite-type chalcogenide validated that stoichiometric Bi2Te3 exhibits reproducibility under ambient and extreme thermal conditions.

title: Microstructural and Functional Evolution of Sb2Te3
abstract: Investigation of grain boundary dynamics and chemical ordering in antimony telluride via high-resolution electron microscopy.
text: Transmission electron microscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy of telluroantimony identified defect ordering characteristic of Sb2.0Te3.0. The material exhibits p-type thermoelectric with large Seebeck coefficient, topological insulator with single Dirac cone at the Gamma point.. In-situ annealing of p-type Sb2Te3 demonstrates enhanced structural stability without secondary phase precipitation.

title: Electrochemical and Optoelectronic Performance of Bi2Se3
abstract: Comprehensive evaluation of charge transport, electronic band structure, and stability in Bi2Se3 3D topological insulator.
text: Electrochemical impedance and spectroscopic measurements on bismuth(III) selenide reveal rapid charge kinetics and low interfacial resistance. Specifically, rhombohedral selenide demonstrates prototypical 3D topological insulator with large bulk bandgap of 0.3 eV and robust spin-polarized Dirac cone surface states.. Comparative analysis confirms that Bi2.0Se3.0 maintains high cycling efficiency over extended operational tests.

title: Advanced Characterization and Defect Engineering in SnSe
abstract: Defect chemistry and local atomic coordination in orthorhombic Pnma selenide investigated by X-ray absorption spectroscopy.

The material displays ultra-low lattice thermal conductivity due to strong lattice anharmonicity, record thermoelectric figure of merit ZT of 2.6 at 923 K.. Modulating synthesis parameters for SnSe directly optimizes functional performance.
